data.name: Subtitle
data.value: A multi-stage pipeline from source to execution

data.name: SelectHint
data.value: Select a stage above to see what it does.

data.name: Explain_Lexer
data.value: A single-pass scan turns the raw TypeScript source into a stream of tokens — keywords, identifiers, literals, and operators — the vocabulary the parser reads.

data.name: Explain_Parser
data.value: A recursive-descent parser reads the tokens and builds an Abstract Syntax Tree of immutable records, desugaring constructs like for-loops into while-loops and expanding destructuring along the way.

data.name: Explain_TypeChecker
data.value: Statically validates the AST against TypeScript's type rules before anything runs — nominal typing for classes, structural typing for interfaces. Type errors stop the program here.

data.name: Explain_Interpreter
data.value: Tree-walks the validated AST and executes it directly, with no build step — the fast path behind the REPL and the playground. Runtime values live in their own environment, separate from the types.

data.name: Explain_ILCompiler
data.value: The ahead-of-time path: lowers the program to .NET IL across roughly twenty phases — closures become display classes, async and generators become state machines — and emits a real .NET assembly.
